title: Penny Penguin's First Day at Preschool: Making Friends!

lines.text: Penny the penguin held her father's flipper tight as they walked to the preschool door!
lines.caps: Penny the penguin held her father's flipper *TIGHT | as they walked to the preschool *DOOR!

lines.text: Her tummy did backflips and she worried, What if nobody wants to play with me?
lines.caps: Her tummy did backflips and she *WORRIED, | What if nobody wants to play with *ME?

lines.text: Inside the classroom, animals were singing songs, stacking blocks, and coloring murals!
lines.caps: Inside the classroom, animals were singing *SONGS, | stacking blocks, and coloring *MURALS!

lines.text: Penny stood shyly in the corner until she noticed a bear cub trying to build an igloo!
lines.caps: Penny stood shyly in the corner until she noticed a bear cub trying to build an *IGLOO!

lines.text: She took a deep breath, smiled brightly, and said, Hi, my name is Penny! Can I help you?
lines.caps: She took a deep breath, smiled brightly, and *SAID, | Hi, my name is Penny! Can I help *YOU?

lines.text: The cub beamed and handed her a big blue ice block! They laughed and built an arctic fortress!
lines.caps: The cub beamed and handed her a big blue ice *BLOCK! | They laughed and built an arctic *FORTRESS!

lines.text: Making a friend starts with just three magical words: Hi, want to play?
lines.caps: Making a friend starts with just three magical *WORDS: | Hi, want to *PLAY?

lines.text: Everyone feels shy sometimes, but a friendly smile opens doors to wonderful friendships!
lines.caps: Everyone feels shy sometimes, but a friendly smile opens doors to *WONDERFUL | *FRIENDSHIPS!

lines.text: Make new friends and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
